name: Agent packages
auth: APM sends AW_TOKEN as a Bearer token via APM_REGISTRY_TOKEN_AW. READ resolves packages; DEPLOY publishes. Use a token issued for the intended principal and repository grants; do not use the upstream service credential.
fresh_home: AW_APM_HOME is a newly created directory. Prefix every apm command with env HOME="$AW_APM_HOME" to isolate configuration and caches.
prerequisites: HTTPS origin trusted by the client. APM_EXTRA_CA_BUNDLE may name a private CA bundle.
Run publish in a producer directory with apm.yml and included assets; install in a separate consumer project with its own apm.yml.

configure.code:
umask 077
AW_APM_HOME=$(mktemp -d)
export APM_REGISTRY_TOKEN_AW="$AW_TOKEN"
env HOME="$AW_APM_HOME" apm experimental enable registries
env HOME="$AW_APM_HOME" apm config set registry.aw.url "$AW_URL/artifactory/api/agentpackages/$AW_REPO"
env HOME="$AW_APM_HOME" apm config set registry.aw.default true
configure.note: The client registry alias is aw; it does not have to equal the repository key.

configure.code:
name: my-pkg
version: 1.0.0
includes: auto
dependencies:
  apm: []
  mcp: []
scripts: {}
configure.note: producer/apm.yml; add the content to package, such as .apm/skills/help/SKILL.md. Use a distinct name/version in consumer/apm.yml.

steps.code: env HOME="$AW_APM_HOME" apm publish --package acme/my-pkg --registry aw

install.note: Run from the separate consumer directory. Exact and ranged resolution are tested.

steps.code: env HOME="$AW_APM_HOME" apm install acme/my-pkg#1.0.0 --target claude

limitations: Registry support is explicitly enabled as an experimental feature in this pinned APM release.
Remote and virtual classes are unsupported; federated proof is one node.
The JFrog CLI is used for other agent formats; this format has actual native APM publish/install proof.
